name: Monmusu Quest! Zenshou ~Makereba Youjo ni Okasareru~
original_name: もんむす・くえすと!前章 ～負ければ妖女に犯される～
source:
In a world where monsters take the forms of women who lust after a substance only men can give them, one boy is fated to change everything forever. And to continuously get raped doing so.
The plot starts when Luka, hero of this story, has a dream of the goddess Ilias who commands him to take up arms, become a hero worthy of her and slay the Monster Lord whose legions of monster girls attack humans everywhere.

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Monster_Girl_Quest!_Chapter_1]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
translation:
在一个怪物化身为女性的世界里，她们渴望获得只有男性才能给予她们的物质，一个男孩注定要永远改变一切。并不断地被强奸。
故事开始时，故事的英雄卢卡梦见了女神伊利亚斯，女神命令他拿起武器，成为配得上她的英雄，并杀死怪物领主，怪物领主的怪物女孩军团到处攻击人类。

[来自[url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Monster_Girl_Quest!_Chapter_1]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
